risks.risk: PS4 model variant is unclear (Fat vs Slim vs Pro). Price varies a lot by variant and storage.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 variant (worst case) among the comparables.

risks.risk: “5 games installed” may be incorrect or may require accounts/online access.
risks.proof: Ask for a video/clip of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (with game icons) after signing in.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no guaranteed games).

risks.risk: “All ports working” may be false (HDMI/USB ports can be faulty).
risks.proof: Ask for a short clip showing HDMI connected to a TV and at least 2 USB devices/controllers recognized (controller pairing + one USB device).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume potential port issues.

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired / no overheating” can’t be verified remotely; thermal paste/fan issues may exist.
risks.proof: Ask for a power-on video plus a quick run of a game for 10–15 minutes showing no shutdown and stable fan behavior (or a temperature readout if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing maintenance (worst case).

risks.risk: Receipt/original accessories may not be included or may not match the console.
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of the receipt and all included items laid out (controllers, cables, etc.).

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 model/serial label (back/bottom) with model number (CUH-xxxx) and storage info if visible.
Video clip of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (confirming exactly 5 games).
Video clip showing HDMI output working on a TV and USB ports working (controller recognized + one USB test).
Video clip of the console running a game for 10–15 minutes to check for overheating/shutdown.
Photos of the receipt and a laid-out accessories shot (controllers + cables) to confirm “original pads” and receipt inclusion.
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 console with controllers, but it does not verify the key pricing drivers (exact PS4 variant, installed games count, port functionality, overheating/repair history, and receipt/original accessories). Without these, a safe worst-case price can’t be confidently selected from the comparables.
